# frac-01 equivalent fractions: every example typed as a division, with fraction display on
# (FDISP after FIX4, as the setup presses BLUE →FRAC). ID@alg is the expression line (firmware 029:
# the result is ANS, N=, the line %LINE=); ID@rpn is the stack. Generated by build/proto/frac01.py.
